# House of Guineas Pet Care

> San Francisco, Peninsula & Marin exotic pet care. In-home pet sitting and SF-based boarding for guinea pigs, rabbits, chinchillas, ferrets, hamsters, reptiles, and birds — run by Alexandria Brown, a former exotic veterinary assistant at Bay Area Bird & Exotics Hospital and a House Rabbit Society medical-assistant volunteer. Also makers of the Clinical Series all-in-one antimicrobial guinea pig fleece cage liner. Phone: 415-484-6493.

## Services & rates
- [Services & Rates](https://www.houseofguineas.com/services/): In-home visits from $85; SF boarding $75/night.
- [How much does exotic pet sitting cost? (SF & Peninsula)](https://www.houseofguineas.com/post/exotic-pet-sitting-cost-san-francisco/): In-home visits from $85; twice-daily $140–$190/day; boarding $75/night; SF has no travel surcharge, Peninsula from $15/visit.
- [In-home exotic pet sitting (SF & Peninsula)](https://www.houseofguineas.com/home/services/exotic-pet-care-services-in-home/)
- [Routine & recurring care (standing 2–3 visits/week for busy pet parents; flat monthly plans)](https://www.houseofguineas.com/routine-recurring-exotic-pet-care/): 30-min visits $158/week ($680/mo) for 2×/week or $223/week ($960/mo) for 3×/week within SF; per-visit travel from $15–$25/visit by distance for Peninsula/farther clients.
- [Exotic pet boarding (hosted in San Francisco)](https://www.houseofguineas.com/home/services/exotic-pet-care-services-boarding/)
- [Book / request care online](https://www.houseofguineas.com/book/)
- [About Alexandria — credentials & veterinary experience](https://www.houseofguineas.com/about/)

## Product
- [Clinical Series guinea pig fleece cage liners](https://www.houseofguineas.com/clinical-series-guinea-pig-fleece-cage-liners/): All-in-one (waterproof base + absorption core + fleece top in one piece), antimicrobial silver-ion throughout, pre-activated, lasts 6+ years. $465 for two; handmade in San Francisco.
